content.bridge_context: Learning about the geographical and political relationships with neighboring countries.

units.title: India's Borders
units.explanation: India shares land borders with 7 countries and sea borders with 2.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name two neighboring countries. / दो पड़ोसी देशों के नाम बताएं।

units.title: Cultural Ties
units.explanation: Shared history, language, and traditions with neighbors like Nepal, Sri Lanka, etc.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify a common festival shared with a neighbor. / एक पड़ोसी के साथ मनाए जाने वाले सामान्य त्योहार की पहचान करें।
